item.erutosmobs.shearwater_feather.desc: Brew into an Awkward Potion for Storm Crossing
jei.erutosmobs.shearwater_feather.info: A shearwater always drops one when it dies. Throw a raw cod, salmon or tropical fish on the water near one: it dives to eat it, trusts you for 5 minutes and flies alongside your boat. If it flies with you to the end, it drops a feather for you. Brew it into an Awkward Potion for Storm Crossing (add redstone for a longer one).
jei.erutosmobs.shearwater.info: A legendary seabird. Only one appears in a wide area of ocean, more often during thunderstorms. It flies alongside boats at sea and shares Storm Crossing with you while it does (lightning does not strike you; swimming and boats are faster). Whoever hurts it earns the Storm's Wrath.
effect.erutosmobs.storm_crossing.descrip: Lightning does not strike you. You swim faster, and your boat goes faster on water.
effect.erutosmobs.storm_wrath.descriptio: You hurt a shearwater. Lightning falls near you in storms and near shearwaters, and they will not fly with you or take your fish. Milk does not help.
advancements.erutosmobs.shearwater.shear: Watch a shearwater cut the waves with its wingtip, up close
advancements.erutosmobs.shearwater.fed.d: Throw a raw fish on the water and let a shearwater eat it
advancements.erutosmobs.shearwater.follo: Have a shearwater fly alongside your boat for 30 seconds
Receive a flight feather from a shearwater that flew with your boat to the end
advancements.erutosmobs.shearwater.wrath: Hurt a shearwater and earn the storm's wrath
